methods.name: abstract boolean hasExtensions(MessageLite prototype)
methods.comment: Returns true for messages that support extensions.

methods.name: abstract FieldSet<T> getExtensions(Object message)
methods.comment: Returns the extension {@link FieldSet} for the message instance.

methods.name: abstract void setExtensions(Object message, FieldSet<T> extensions)
methods.comment: Replaces the extension {@link FieldSet} for the message instance.

methods.name: abstract FieldSet<T> getMutableExtensions(Object message)
methods.comment: Returns the extension {@link FieldSet} and ensures it's mutable.

methods.name: abstract void makeImmutable(Object message)
methods.comment: Marks the extension {@link FieldSet} as immutable.

methods.name: abstract UB parseExtension(Object containerMessage, Reader reader, Object extension, ExtensionRegistryLite extensionRegistry, FieldSet<T> extensions, UB unknownFields, UnknownFieldSchema<UT, UB> unknownFieldSchema) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Parses an extension. Returns the passed-in unknownFields parameter if no unknown enum value is
   * found or a modified unknownFields (a new instance if the passed-in unknownFields is null)
   * containing unknown enum values found while parsing.
   *
   * @param <UT> The type used to store unknown fields. It's either UnknownFieldSet in full runtime
   *     or UnknownFieldSetLite in lite runtime.

methods.name: abstract int extensionNumber(Map.Entry<?, ?> extension)
methods.comment: Gets the field number of an extension entry.

methods.name: abstract void serializeExtension(Writer writer, Map.Entry<?, ?> extension) throws IOException
abstract Object findExtensionByNumber(ExtensionRegistryLite extensionRegistry, MessageLite defaultInstance, int number)
methods.comment: Finds an extension by field number.

methods.name: abstract void parseLengthPrefixedMessageSetItem(Reader reader, Object extension, ExtensionRegistryLite extensionRegistry, FieldSet<T> extensions) throws IOException
methods.comment: Parses a length-prefixed MessageSet item from the reader.

methods.name: abstract void parseMessageSetItem(ByteString data, Object extension, ExtensionRegistryLite extensionRegistry, FieldSet<T> extensions) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Parses the entire content of a {@link ByteString} as one MessageSet item. Unlike {@link
   * #parseLengthPrefixedMessageSetItem}, there isn't a length-prefix.
